name: Tabs with a grain indicator
for: A tab bar for a product tour or a dashboard preview: the active pill is a small window of a still, low-contrast grain in the accent, and it glides to the tab you choose while the panel below changes.
how: The effect spans the whole bar and stays put, in a palette within a few steps of the accent so the active label reads; the pill is a clip-path window that slides over it, so nothing is redrawn or resized. The grain is still (speed 0, grainMotion 0). 'flat' mounts nothing and keeps the plain accent. On a phone the bar scrolls sideways with a faded far edge.
rules: One tab bar like this per page; the label on it keeps 4.5:1.
The pill never shines, folds or streaks: no silk, glass or metal looks, no motion inside it.
The indicator moves only when a tab is chosen, never on a timer.
Panels hold real product content, not lorem.
a11y: ARIA tabs: tablist, tabs with aria-selected and aria-controls, roving tabindex, arrow keys, Home and End; panels are focusable. Reduced motion jumps instead of gliding.
